name: policy-session-duration-override
query: I set session_duration = '720h' on my Access app for an MCP server because daily re-auth annoys the team. Users still get kicked out after 24h. The dashboard app page shows 720h. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Identifies the cause: the policy's session_duration overrides the app's. With it omitted on the policy, Cloudflare uses the policy default (24h) regardless of the app setting.
Fix: set session_duration = "720h" on the cloudflare_zero_trust_access_policy too so they match.
Notes this is silent — Terraform plan shows no warning, the dashboard app tab shows the app's value, only the effective session reveals the override.
Suggests leaving a code comment so the next person doesn't trip on it.
Does NOT blame browser cookie expiry or IdP token TTL.
Does NOT suggest filing a Cloudflare bug.
